about: Palette catalog for lt-suite. Each entry gives colour roles; ltcore.palettes.derive_theme() turns them into a diagram theme. Ranking fields (score, rank) are measured on the derived theme by python3 -m ltcore.palettes rank; licence fields are never read by the ranking.

palettes.name: Okabe-Ito (Wong 2011)

licence.attribution: Colour Universal Design palette by Masataka Okabe and Kei Ito (https://jfly.uni-koeln.de/color/); popularised by B. Wong, Nature Methods 8, 441 (2011). Used with credit as the authors ask.

palettes.claim: Colour Universal Design palette of 8 colours that Okabe and Ito propose as a colour-blind barrier-free set ('recognizable also to protanopes'); popularised by Wong, Nature Methods, 2011
assumptions: background #ffffff and text #000000 are stated assumptions: the author designs for a white background; no documented dark background exists, so no dark variant is made
black is a palette member and is used as the text role; accents are the other 7 in the canonical order
